thread:
julia (PM): Dropping a new compact invite + roles draft. Main goals: tighter matrix for heavy users, and make SSO enforcement impossible to miss during invite. Quick skim please: https://figma.com/file/dense-invite-2183 :mag_right:

omar (Designer): I pushed a few variants: 1) badge + info icon, 2) inline toggle before CTA, 3) hybrid where pill is shown and toggle appears when role selected. My preference is hybrid (less visual weight until needed).

nate (Frontend): Hybrid seems good but be careful with focus order. In variant 3 the toggle appears dynamically which can shift layout and move the CTA. That surprises keyboard users. We should reserve space to avoid reflow.

kevin (Backend): From API side we'll add `sso_required` to the roles list and return an `invite_event_id` on create. Also we can provide a preflight endpoint `POST /invites/preview` to validate SSO requirements before final submit if you want instant inline validation.

julia (PM): Preflight sounds useful for forms where we want to validate early. Nate, can frontend call preview on role select? Keep it cheap.

nate (Frontend): Yep, we'll debounce the preview call. If preview returns mismatch, show inline validation and surface the toggle. If org enforces SSO tenant-wide, the toggle should be disabled with tooltip "SSO enforced by org".

sana (a11y): A11y checklist: 1) Pill + toggle need 4.5:1 contrast. 2) When a role requiring SSO is selected we must update an aria-live region: e.g., "Selected role: Security Admin. Requires SSO." 3) Ensure dynamic content insertion doesn't steal focus; instead announce then move focus only on user request.

omar (Designer): For copy on the pill I'm trying "SSO only" (compact) and tooltip copy: "This role requires signing in via your org's SSO provider." Also adding a tiny "Why?" link that opens a modal with short explanations and a link to docs.

nate (Frontend): Implementation notes: 1) reserve an 48px slot in the layout to avoid push when toggle appears; 2) use `aria-live="polite"` span with sr-only class for SR announcements; 3) make the pill tabbable but not first stop so tab flow goes input -> role -> pill/info -> send.

sana (a11y): For the info modal use `role="dialog"`, trap focus, and on close return focus to the info button. Also prefer `aria-modal="true"` and a clear h1 in the modal. Test with VoiceOver and NVDA.

kevin (Backend): For deep-linking to audit: we'll accept `?highlight=invite:<event_id>&context=modal`. The invite response will contain `invite_event_id` so frontend can navigate to `/audit?highlight=...` after creating invite.

julia (PM): UX detail: when deep-linking from the modal, show a tiny chip next to filters: "From invite modal" and blink or pulse the matched audit row for ~1.2s. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

omar (Designer): I'll prototype the chip and a subtle pulse (solid outline then fade). We'll switch to a static outline for reduced-motion users.

nate (Frontend): For the pulse I'll implement CSS transition but guard with `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { ... }` and fallback to adding a `.focused` class that applies a 2px solid border.

sana (a11y): Also ensure the highlight grants keyboard focusability — either set tabindex=0 on the highlighted row or move focus to it, depending on context. If we move focus, announce why: "Focused audit entry from invite modal."

ci-bot: note: flagged as UI change; no infra changes required.

julia (PM): Plan/owners: Omar update figma by EOD with hybrid layout + modal copy. Kevin to add `sso_required` & `invite_event_id` and optional preview endpoint. Nate will prototype keyboard + live region + preserved space for toggle. Sana will test a11y when PR is ready. Ping here if stuck. :rocket:
